parameters.query: SELECT jsonb_build_object('postulacion_id',$1,'analysis_id',$2,'vacancy_id',$3,'scoring_version',$4,'scoring_version_id',config.id,'candidate',candidate_data.structured_output,'vacancy',to_jsonb(vacancy),'criteria',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(criterion) ORDER BY criterion.evaluation_order) FROM talentflow.scoring_criteria criterion WHERE criterion.scoring_config_version_id=config.id),'[]'::jsonb),'desirables',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(desirable) ORDER BY desirable.display_order) FROM talentflow.desirable_requirements desirable WHERE desirable.scoring_config_version_id=config.id),'[]'::jsonb),'added_values',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(added_value) ORDER BY added_value.display_order) FROM talentflow.added_value_requirements added_value WHERE added_value.scoring_config_version_id=config.id),'[]'::jsonb)) AS data FROM talentflow.applications application JOIN talentflow.vacancies vacancy ON vacancy.id=application.vacancy_id JOIN talentflow.ai_analyses candidate_data ON candidate_data.id=$2::uuid AND candidate_data.application_id=application.id AND candidate_data.analysis_type='CV_EXTRACTION' AND candidate_data.status='SUCCEEDED' JOIN talentflow.scoring_config_versions config ON config.vacancy_id=vacancy.id AND config.version=$4::integer WHERE application.id=$1::uuid AND application.vacancy_id=$3::uuid AND config.id=(SELECT id FROM talentflow.scoring_config_versions WHERE vacancy_id=$3::uuid AND version=$4::integer)

required=Number.isFinite(configured)&&configured>=0?configured:Number(context.vacancy.minimum_experience_months||0)/12;matched=required===0||years>=required;points=required===0?weight:Math.min(years/required,1)*weight;explanation=`Experiencia desired=match(context.desirables),added=match(context.added_values);const minRaw=Number(context.vacancy.expected_experience_min_months??context.vacancy.minimum_experience_months),maxRaw=Number(context.vacancy.expected_experience_max_months);const
